prediction.calibration_source: IEA Energy Policy Reviews 2018-2023; BloombergNEF Power Sector Outlook 2019-2023; Eurostat + IRENA national renewable-share time series. All public.

kill_condition.rule: pass if 5.0 ≤ mean_lead_time ≤ 12.0; fail if outside the window
kill_condition.rationale: The 'policy precedes deployment' lag is documented in public IEA + BNEF + IRENA sources as the structural window between a regulatory anchor (feed-in tariff law / national renewable target) and observed share-inflection (the year the share trajectory begins its steep growth phase). A methodology-layer prior recovering this window supports eirmath's use of the prior to forward-predict from a follower country's recently-passed analog milestone.

verdict.rationale: Mean lead time 8.83y across 6 leader countries (range 7-12y) sits inside the pre-committed window [5.0, 12.0]y. The methodology recovers the 'policy precedes deployment' structural lag documented in public IEA + BNEF + IRENA sources. Eirmath can use this as the calibration anchor for forward-prediction from follower-country analog milestones. Per §1 honesty bounds, this voice does NOT claim any specific country's future trajectory; it claims a prior over lead times from the leader-cohort fixture.
